title: Audit head for monitoring
description: The monitor_audit_head delivery: the signed head of the tenant's audit chain in the history of the monitoring system at least once a day (MON-3, AUD-6). The core signs it.

epoch.description: Store epoch in which the head was issued. A restore from backup starts a new epoch with a restore record in the farm chain; a smaller seq is allowed only with a larger epoch (spec/hashing.md, RET-6, D-86 (7)).

seq.description: Number of the last audit record; within one epoch it only grows.

sig.description: Signature with the core key over the object {type: botaru.audit-head.v1, tenant, epoch, seq, hash, key_id} in the RFC 8785 form (spec/hashing.md).
